items.question: Which marketing channel brought the most net revenue in 2025?
items.sql:
SELECT
  channel_name,
  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(net_revenue_usd)) OVER (), 0), 4) AS revenue_share
FROM order_revenue
WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY SUM(net_revenue_usd) DESC;

items.question: How many refunds with the reason 'defective' did each product category have in 2025?
items.sql:
SELECT olr.parent_category_name AS parent_category,
       olr.category_name AS category,
       COUNT(r.id) AS defective_refunds
FROM refunds r
JOIN order_line_revenue olr
  ON olr.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
WHERE r.reason = 'defective'
  AND olr.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND olr.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY olr.parent_category_name, olr.category_name
ORDER BY defective_refunds DESC, category;

items.question: Show net revenue for each month of 2026 with the difference in USD from the previous month
items.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date)::date AS month,
         SUM(net_revenue_usd) AS net_revenue
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), with_prev AS (
  SELECT month,
         net_revenue,
         LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_net_revenue
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(net_revenue, 2) AS net_revenue_usd,
       ROUND(prev_net_revenue, 2) AS prev_month_net_revenue_usd,
       ROUND(net_revenue - prev_net_revenue, 2) AS diff_usd,
       ROUND((net_revenue - prev_net_revenue) / NULLIF(prev_net_revenue, 0), 4) AS pct_change
FROM with_prev
WHERE month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
ORDER BY month;

items.question: Year over year, how did net revenue in calendar Q3 2026 compare with calendar Q3 2025 for each region?
items.sql:
SELECT
  region_code,
  region_name,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q3_2026_net_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q3_2025_net_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS difference,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END))
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS pct_change
FROM order_revenue
WHERE (ordered_at >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2025-10-01')
   OR (ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01')
GROUP BY region_code, region_name
ORDER BY q3_2026_net_revenue DESC;

items.question: Which region had the highest refund rate in 2025?
items.sql:
SELECT region_code,
       region_name,
       ROUND(SUM(gross_revenue_usd), 2) AS gross_revenue_usd,
       ROUND(SUM(refund_usd), 2) AS refunds_usd,
       ROUND(SUM(refund_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_revenue_usd), 0), 4) AS refund_rate
FROM order_revenue
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY region_code, region_name
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC NULLS LAST;

items.question: For each first-order month in 2025, how many new customers were there and how many of them placed another order within 60 days?
items.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         first_order_at,
         date_trunc('month', first_order_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS first_order_month
  FROM customer_profile
  WHERE first_order_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND first_order_at <  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
repeaters AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN order_revenue o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
   AND o.ordered_at >= c.first_order_at
   AND o.ordered_at <  c.first_order_at + INTERVAL '60 days'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT c.first_order_month,
       COUNT(*) AS new_customers,
       COUNT(r.customer_id) AS repeat_within_60d,
       ROUND(COUNT(r.customer_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS repeat_rate_60d
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN repeaters r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.first_order_month
ORDER BY c.first_order_month;

items.question: What is the average number of orders per customer by acquisition channel, for customers who signed up in 2025?
items.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(acquisition_channel, 'Unknown') AS acquisition_channel,
       COUNT(*) AS customers,
       SUM(COALESCE(order_count, 0)) AS total_orders,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(order_count, 0))::numeric, 4) AS avg_orders_per_customer
FROM customer_profile
WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY COALESCE(acquisition_channel, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY avg_orders_per_customer DESC;

items.question: How many EU orders were placed between 18:00 and midnight Berlin time in September 2026 (Berlin dates)?
items.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS eu_evening_orders
FROM order_revenue o
WHERE o.region_code = 'EU'
  AND (o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND (o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') <  TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')) >= 18;

items.question: Now by month
items.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT region_code,
         region_name,
         DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date AS month,
         SUM(net_revenue_usd) AS net_revenue
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY region_code, region_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)
)
SELECT region_code,
       region_name,
       month,
       ROUND(net_revenue, 2) AS net_revenue_usd,
       ROUND(LAG(net_revenue) OVER w, 2) AS prev_month_net_revenue_usd,
       ROUND(net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER w, 2) AS difference,
       ROUND((net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER w) / NULLIF(LAG(net_revenue) OVER w, 0), 4) AS pct_change
FROM monthly
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY month)
ORDER BY region_code, month;

items.question: Which EU country drove the drop from the second to the third calendar quarter?
items.sql:
SELECT country_code,
       ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 2) AS net_revenue_q2_2026,
       ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'), 2) AS net_revenue_q3_2026,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'), 0)
           - COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 0), 2) AS difference,
       ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'), 0)
           - COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 0))
           / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 0), 4) AS pct_change,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gross_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'), 0)
           - COALESCE(SUM(gross_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 0), 2) AS gross_revenue_difference,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(refund_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'), 0)
           - COALESCE(SUM(refund_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 0), 2) AS refund_difference
FROM order_revenue
WHERE region_code = 'EU'
  AND ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY difference ASC NULLS LAST;
